name: VaultProof
description: Active Key Protection: selling to security buyers, design partners, investors and a security-first build. Tuned for VaultProof's go-to-market and engineering.

chief-of-staff: Put design partners, investor follow-ups and security incidents first in the morning briefing.
gtm: Security buyers first: lead with the risk of live API keys in their stack, then how VaultProof removes it.
Never claim a certification, customer or number that is not in memory as a stated fact.
code: Treat anything touching keys, tokens or the proxy as security-sensitive: ask before planning changes there.
Every engineering issue that touches credentials lists how it will be tested.
research: Track breaches involving leaked API keys and summarize what VaultProof would have prevented, with sources.

skills.name: security-buyer-outreach
skills.description: Use for first outreach to a CISO or security lead.
steps: Search memory for the company, contact and any past touch
Find one recent, specific risk they face (with a source)
Explain in one sentence how live keys create that risk
Offer a 20-minute call as the only ask
Keep it under 120 words and draft it for review

skills.name: breach-news-triage
skills.description: Use when a breach or key leak is in the news.
steps: Research what leaked and how, with sources
Decide if leaked API keys or tokens were involved
Save the finding to memory with its source
If relevant, create an issue to use it in outreach or content

issues.title: List current design partners and their next step
Collect three recent breaches caused by leaked API keys

interview.priorities: Sign design partners; ship the MCP server
